charge_port.notes: Estimated: North American EX40/XC40 Recharge use CCS1 (the 2026 EX40 is confirmed CCS by a Canadian Volvo dealer article, and Volvo sells a NACS-to-CCS1 adapter for all its EVs, which would be pointless with a native NACS port). Nothing shows a port change between 2021 and 2026 (no native NACS on any Volvo EV before the EX60). Applies to 2023 Twin.

wheels.notes: 2023 page lists no wheel data; carried from the 2022 P8 Twin and 2025 EX40 pages (both 19 in).

heat_pump.notes: US: climate pack (includes a heat pump) optional on Core/Plus, standard on Ultimate. Canada carried from 2022 (Canadian Climate Package incl. heat pump). "Optional" here means a package on lower trims (Core/Plus) and standard on the top trim (Ultra/Ultimate); this record holds one trim.
